data.final_week_advice: Finish with a mock exam and a quick self‑assessment of confidence levels for each unit.
data.summary: A concise two‑week plan that tackles the student’s weak Acids and Bases unit first, then consolidates all topics with a mixed review and timed practice before the exam.

tasks: Watch the live class 9100 and take detailed notes on pH calculations.
Do 15 practice problems on strong acid/base pH and pOH, then self‑grade using the rubric.
Review the class notes and create a one‑page cheat sheet summarizing key formulas and concepts.
Complete a full-length AP Chemistry practice test (timed) and mark each answer with the scoring guide.
Identify the top three weak areas from the test and review the corresponding textbook sections.
Do a 30‑minute timed quiz on equilibrium constants and Gibbs free energy, then analyze errors.
